t: Tepillat musap beqol ram veseder hatteqiot
s: Tepillat musap beqol ram veseder hatteqiot ubo y"a seipim: keshemmitpalelim tepillat musap betzibbur tiqqenu chakamim litqoa tr"t lemalkuyyot tr"t lezikronot vetar"t leshoparot, ulepi shebbitpillat musap belachash kol echad veechad mitpallel leatzmo veen echad mesayyem birkotayv beshaa shechabero mesayyem, lepikak en toqein bitpilla zo kemo sheen toqein beyachid kemo sheyyitbaer, ella mamtinin millitqoa ad sheyyachazor hashsheliach tzibbur et hattepilla. Veyesh meqomot shennohagin litqoa b' peamim achat bitpillat lachash veachat bachazarat hashsheliach tzibbur, abal bemaqom sheen minhag en linhog ken lekattechilla:

Teqiot ellu niqraim teqiot meummad, lepi sheap hashshomein tzerikin laamod beet shemiat teqiot hallalu, mah sheen ken bitqiot meyushshab sheen tzarik laamod ella hattoqea bilbad kemo shennitbaer besiman tqp"h:

Veakshav shettiqqenu lanu chakamim latzet mide kol hassepeqot sheyyesh lehistappeq bitrua, kemo shennitbaer besiman tq"tz ayyen sham, haya meharauy litqoa tshr"t tsh"t tr"t lemalkuyyot veken lezikronot veken leshoparot kede latzet mikkol hassepeqot shel terua, ella lepi sheen matrichin al hatztzibbur en nohagin litqoa ella tshr"t lemalkuyyot veken lezikronot veken leshoparot, shehare bederek zo hu oseh kol hassepeqot shel terua, veen kan chashash ella (shemma hatterua enah ella shebarim lebad uterua lebad venimtza) shemma hu mapsiq ben terua lipshuta shellepaneha o shelleachareha, veen anu chosheshin lazeh kevan shekkebar yatzanu yede choba min hattora bitqiot meyushshab, shebbatteqiot hahem yatzanu mikkol hassepeqot kemo shennitbaer besiman tq"tz:

Veyesh nohagin litqoa lemalkuyyot tshr"t paam achat ulezikronot tsh"t uleshoparot tr"t, lepi shemmin hattora ben shebarim ben terua shellanu hakkol niqra terua, veek sheyyaaseh adam ben shebarim lebad ben terua shellanu lebad hu yotze yede chobato. Ubaddorot harishonim hayu miqtzat meqomot nohagin laasot shebarim umiqtzat nohagin laasot terua shellanu, veellu vaellu yotzein yede chobatan min hattora. Ella lepi shehaya haddabar nireh kemachaloqet beene hehamon, laken rau chakamim letaqqen sheyyihyu kol yisrael osin maaseh echad velo yeraeh benehem dabar shennireh kemachaloqet beene hehamon, hitqinu litqoa tshr"t g' peamim tsh"t g' peamim vetar"t g' peamim kede latzet missepeqot hehamon mechamat chaluqqat minhagim, lepikak lo hitrichu al hatztzibbur litqoa kadderek hazzeh gam bitqiot meummad, ella marin bitqiot meummad shekkol sepeqot hatterua hen niqraim terua veadam yotze bahem yede chobato, ulekak toqein paam achat tshr"t paam achat tsh"t paam achat tr"t kede leharot shekkol echad veechad missedarim hallalu hen nekonim ukesherim:

Yesh nohagin litqoa g' peamim tshr"t lemalkuyyot g' peamim tsh"t lezikronot veg' peamim tr"t leshoparot. Veyesh nohagin litqoa tshr"t tsh"t tr"t lemalkuyyot veken lezikronot veken leshoparot. Uminhag zeh hu hammubchar shebbamminhagim:
Venohagim lomar bekol paam shettoqein "hayyom harat olam veku'", "areshet sepatenu veku'". Vaapillu keshechal beshabbat sheen toqein omerim "hayyom harat ku'", abal en omerim "areshet ku'":

Hammitpallel musap beyachid — en mapsiq kede litqoa seder habberakot, vaapillu yesh lo mi shettoqea lo en mapsiq leshomam, shello tiqqenu ella betzibbur. Umikkol maqom, hatteqiot shechayyab lishmoa min hattora, dehaynu tshr"t g' peamim tsh"t g' peamim tr"t g' peamim, tob sheyyishma otan qodem tepillat musap. Ap al pi shetteqiot meummad hen mitzva middibre soperim ap al pi ken en mebarekin alehen kemo shemmebarekin al kol mitzva middibre soperim, lepi shenniptarin babberaka shebbereku al teqiot meyushshab. Vekevan shehen niptarin bibraka achat laken yesh lizzaher shello lehapsiq benehem besicha, velo hattoqea bilbad shebberak al hashshopar, ella apillu hatztzibbur shello bereku leatzman ella shameu birkat hashshopar mehattoqea ap hen lo yasichu mittechillat teqiot meyushshab ad achar teqiot meummad. Veim abar vesach ben hattoqea ben hashshomein — en tzarik lebarek al teqiot meummad. Veap shehappoter shette mitzvot bibraka achat vesach benehem tzarik lachazor ulebarek al mitzva hashshenit kemo shennitbaer besiman ch' ubesiman k"h, mikkol maqom kevan sheellu hatteqiot meummad umeyushshab hen keen mitzva achat, shehattora chiyyeba otanu lishmoa tesha teqiot berosh hashshana, vetiqqenu chakamim lishmoa otan al seder birkot malkuyyot zikronot veshoparot, ella kede learbeb et hassatan (perush kede sheyyitarbeb miyyad batteqiot shellipne hattepilla velo yeqatreg battepilla) al ken nahagu kol yisrael lechalleq et hatteqiot shel tora veshel dibre soperim lishte peamim, vetoqein meyushshab kede leqayyem mitzva min hattora umebarekin alehen, vegomerin et hammitzva shel dibre soperim bitqiot meummad sheal seder habberakot kemo shettiqqenu chakamim. Vekevan shehen mitzva achat venirin kishte mitzvot, lepikak en lehasiach benehem debarim betelim, abal muttar lehasiach benehem meinyene hattepilla vehatteqiot, kevan shehen beemet mitzva achat. Veken im abar vesach apillu debarim betelim — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek, deen shayyak hepseq beemtza mitzva achat, kemo shehayyosheb bassukka vehallabush tepillin muttar lasuach ap al pi shekkol rega varega shehu yosheb bassukka velabush battepillin hu meqayyem mitzvat haqqadosh baruk hu. Abal im sach ben beraka litqiot meyushshab, apillu sach meinyene hattepillot — tzarik lachazor ulebarek, kevan shehipsiq ben habberaka lehaddabar shemmebarek alayv. Abal im sach meinyene hatteqiot — eno tzarik lachazor ulebarek. Abal lekattechilla asur lasuach ben habberaka latteqia apillu meinyene hatteqiot, ella im ken i epshar lo leqayyem hammitzva im lo yasiach, kegon sheomer tenu li hashshopar vekayyotze bazeh:

Ubishat hatteqiot atzman, ben teqiot meyushshab ben teqiot meummad, asur laroq, lepi shetztzarik lishmoa kol hatteqia meroshah ad sopah apillu hi arukka harbeh kemo shennitbaer besiman tq"tz. Ulepikak en lehabi qetannim shello higgiu lechinnuk lebet hakkeneset beet hatteqiot shello yebalbelu daat hashshomeim, ak hannashim yiqchu otan etzlan shehen peturin kemo shennitbaer besiman tqp"t:
Nohagin shebbitqiot meyushshab oleh hattoqea al habbima vetoqea sham mippene kebod hatztzibbur, abal bitqiot meummad kevan shehen betok hattepilla en matrichin oto laalot ella omed [bimqomo] vetoqea:

Hatteqiot sheal seder habberakot lo yitqa otan hashsheliach tzibbur hammitpallel musap, shemma yitbalbel velo yukal lachazor litpillato belo terup daat, abal im hu mubtach beatzmo shechozer litpillato belo terup daat, o shemmitpallel mittok hassiddur shebbevadday hu mubtach — yukal litqoa ap im yesh adam acher sheyyodea litqoa kemoto, lepi shehatteqia enah hepseq kelal battepilla, kevan shetztzarik litqoa al seder habberakot, im ken hu tzorek hattepilla. Velaken hattoqea teqiot meyushshab rauy sheyyitqa gam ken teqiot meummad, shehammatchil bemitzva omerim lo gemor, ella im ken shehu sheliach tzibbur hammitpallel musap veeno mubtach shechozer litpillato belo terup daat:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Baddorot harishonim shehayu nohagim litqoa bistam, veim ken zaka miyyad bekol hatteqiot apillu shel seder habberakot mittaam shennitbaer, veen lehaabir hammitzva mimmennu, abal akshav shennohagin biqtzat meqomot litten hatteqiot shemmeummad leacher, im ken meolam lo zaka harishon bitqiot meummad, umuttar litten otan leadam acher bekol maqom:
